execution_note: Numerical stress executed locally against an executable transcription of the frozen V3 algorithms/constants. Persisted validator binds the exact repository V3 adapter.

stress.predictable_rule: if prior CLOSED score < .05, next B=256 when prior B=1 else B=1; otherwise next B=4 when prior B>4 else B=128

interpretation: V3 numerical inversion/replay remained stable across exposure weights spanning 1/256 to 1, with zero live/replay e-value or endpoint discrepancy at 180 audited prefixes.

Predictability of weights preserves the statistical contract, but it does not guarantee rapid resolution: none of the tested campaigns crossed the .05 decision or .025/.025 reporting thresholds by 220 blocks.

Equal-process and planned-exposure channels can diverge materially as estimands under extreme block-size oscillation; the representative equal-process mean was about .0246 while the planned-exposure weighted mean was about .0130. This is not a numerical bug and should not be averaged away into one reliability number.
scope_guards: Synthetic stress only; non-resolution is not evidence of invalidity or a production stopping-time prediction.
The next block size used prior CLOSED score/prior B only; realized current completion count never set the current weight.
The stress does not establish behavior below weight 1/256 or under zero weights, which the V3 API forbids.
